results.name: widget_text_edit_process_key
results.evidence: Reads a key/event struct (offset+2 code compared to 0x1d/0x54/0x4f/0x50) and mutates a text-buffer object (in_EAX: ptr, max-len, cur-len, selection) via memmove insert/delete, matching an editable text-field key handler.
results.summary: Handles special edit-key codes on a widget's text buffer, inserting/deleting characters and shifting bytes with memmove while updating cursor/selection fields.

results.name: widget_text_edit_reset_length
results.evidence: Computes strlen of *unaff_ESI and stores it at offset+6 (length field) while clearing offset+2 (selection) to 0xffff, mirroring the length/selection fields used by FUN_0044c5e0/FUN_0044c780.
results.summary: Recomputes and caches a text-edit control's string length and clears its selection after the underlying string changed.

results.name: widget_text_edit_get_selection
results.evidence: Reads in_EAX+8 (max) and in_EAX+6 (length) to clamp and write two output shorts (selection start/end) and returns a success byte, called from the other 0x44c2xx text-edit routines.
results.summary: Computes the clamped selection start/end offsets for a text-edit control and reports whether a selection is active.

results.name: widget_text_edit_insert_string
results.evidence: Uses FUN_0044c5e0 to get selection bounds, then memmoves the tail of the buffer and copies in in_EAX (a C string) byte-by-byte while respecting unaff_ESI[1] (max length), same struct layout as FUN_0044c290/FUN_0044c780.
results.summary: Inserts (or replaces the current selection with) a C string into a widget text-edit buffer, honoring its maximum length.

results.name: widget_text_edit_clamp_selection
results.evidence: Computes string length of *param_1, clamps the cursor field (param_1+6) and selection-anchor field (param_1+2) into [-1,len]/[0,len], then calls FUN_00557720 once or twice on change.
results.summary: Normalizes/clamps a text-edit control's cursor and selection-anchor fields to the current string length and fires a change notification.

results.name: first_person_weapon_interface_tick
results.evidence: Compares a mapped unit's object id (via DAT_0087a478/DAT_0087a480 datum lookups) against the cached value in the DAT_006b2d98[0] (local-player interface, stride 0x1ea0) entry; on change or invalid weapon (offset+8==-1) it calls FUN_00493c60(0) (interface init) then always FUN_00493150(0) (per-tick update).
results.summary: Per-frame entry point for local player 0's first-person weapon interface: re-initializes the cached weapon-interface block when the controlled unit changed, then runs its tick update.

results.name: first_person_weapon_update_active_state
results.evidence: Uses DAT_007c3108 (local player index) and DAT_006b2d98 array (stride 0x1ea0) to check the unit/weapon exist, calls FUN_00445ac0/FUN_00472740 (zoom/action checks) to derive a bool passed into chimera__first_person_node_base_address, then conditionally calls FUN_00493740 (weapon animation-control update) when the interface flag at offset 0 is set.
results.summary: Determines whether the local player's first-person weapon view should be active based on zoom/action state, toggles it, and refreshes weapon animation controls when active.

results.name: first_person_weapon_spawn_effect_from_hud
results.evidence: Validates several datum-table indirections down to a unit's weapon HUD-interface record, checks flag bytes at offsets 0x1d8c/0x1e0e, copies reordered node data via FUN_00493ea0 into a 3332-byte local buffer, and calls FUN_004d6fc0 twice with that buffer plus a shared vector (DAT_007c3114/3118/311c).
results.summary: When the local player's weapon HUD elements are present, gathers first-person weapon node data and dispatches it (twice, for two different HUD interface elements) to a lower-level effect/render routine.

results.name: local_player_index_for_object
results.evidence: Iterates the DAT_006b2d98 interface array (stride 0x1ea0) comparing its weapon/object field (offset+8) to unaff_ESI and its active flag (offset+0); returns the matching index or -1.
results.summary: Finds which local player's interface record currently references the given object, returning -1 if none matches.

results.name: unit_notify_weapon_action
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004940a0 (local-player-by-unit-object lookup) then FUN_004940f0 (weapon action dispatcher) with param_1 as the action code, falling back to FUN_00492990 (notification/sound) when the unit isn't a local player's.
results.summary: Routes a weapon action event for a given unit: applies it locally if the unit belongs to a local player, otherwise plays a fallback notification.

results.name: weapon_notify_action
results.evidence: Same shape as FUN_00492730 but resolves the acting local player via FUN_00494010 (local-player-by-current-weapon lookup) instead of by unit object, then calls FUN_004940f0 and falls back to FUN_00492990.
results.summary: Routes a weapon action event keyed by weapon object: applies it if the weapon belongs to a local player, otherwise plays a fallback notification.

results.name: weapon_type_to_pickup_message_index
results.evidence: Pure switch on in_AX mapping a small enum (0-0x11) to another small enum (mostly 6-0x17), default -1; used immediately before FUN_00492880 inside FUN_00492990's HUD/pickup logic.
results.summary: Remaps a weapon/equipment type enum to a HUD message/animation index used by the pickup-notification logic.

results.name: weapon_type_to_equipment_message_index
results.evidence: Second switch-table remap (0-0x17 -> 0-0x1b) chained after FUN_004927c0 inside FUN_00492990, feeding the resulting index into an animation-list lookup.
results.summary: Second-stage remap of a weapon/equipment type enum into an index used to look up a HUD pickup animation/message entry.

results.name: unit_weapon_notification_sound
results.evidence: Calls object_try_and_get(4), remaps a type via FUN_004927c0/FUN_00492880, indexes into a unit's HUD-interface animation table, checks a battery/ammo item via datum_get, and plays a sound/animation via FUN_00543ce0(iVar3, 0xffffffff, 1.0f, flag).
results.summary: Plays a HUD notification (sound/animation) reflecting a unit's weapon/equipment state, gated on the equipment item actually existing.

results.name: first_person_weapon_get_marker_data
results.evidence: Called by FUN_00492b80 as FUN_00492ad0(weapon_object, "flashlight", local_6c, 1), matching a named-marker transform lookup on the current first-person weapon model, gated on object_try_and_get and HUD flags at offsets 0x1d8c/0x468/0x478.
results.summary: Looks up a named marker (e.g. "flashlight") on the local player's first-person weapon model and returns its transform data.

results.name: first_person_weapon_center_flashlight
results.evidence: String "flashlight" passed to FUN_00492ad0; result fields are used as origin/size/direction, with the output origin offset by half the size vector (typical bounding-box-centering math) - matches the naming-hint cea-pdb match.
results.summary: Computes the centered world-space origin, extents, and direction of the local player's first-person weapon flashlight marker.

results.name: unit_get_first_person_marker_transform
results.evidence: Resolves an object's owning local-player index via nested DAT_008603b0/DAT_0087a480 datum lookups, verifies it equals DAT_007c3108 (current local player) and the unit is alive, then calls FUN_00492ad0 to fill caller-provided position/size/direction outputs, returning success as bool.
results.summary: Fetches a first-person weapon marker's transform for an object, but only if that object belongs to the current local player.

results.name: first_person_weapon_state_dispatch
results.evidence: Switches on the interface record's current state field (offset+0xc) and, for most state groups, calls FUN_00492e60 (a weapon-state setter) with in_DX as the new/candidate state; special-cases states 0xd/0xe/0xf/0x12 with extra HUD-flag checks or a cooldown decrement.
results.summary: Given the local player's current first-person weapon animation state, decides whether/how to transition to a new state via FUN_00492e60.

results.name: first_person_weapon_set_state
results.evidence: Validates state-transition legality against the interface record's current state (offset+0xc), remaps flashlight-related states (0x13/0x14), computes a new animation index via FUN_00492880, and on success writes new state/anim-index/timer fields and optionally calls FUN_004930b0 to snapshot the previous pose.
results.summary: Weapon animation state machine: validates and applies a state transition for the local player's first-person weapon, recording the previous pose for blending when needed.

results.name: first_person_weapon_snapshot_pose
results.evidence: Copies a node-control block from offset+0x8c to offset+0x88c (count derived from the weapon's node/track table) and updates timer bounds at offset+0x88/0x8a; called from FUN_00492e60 when a blended state change occurs.
results.summary: Saves the current first-person weapon animation control block as the 'previous pose' for blending into the next animation state.

results.name: first_person_weapon_update
results.evidence: Per-local-player (param_1) tick: validates the weapon/object via object_try_and_get, forces state changes via FUN_00492e60/FUN_00492d20, updates an idle timer and randomly-chosen idle animation, computes aim-sway via angle_delta_wrapped and FUN_004cf360, and decrements a countdown that calls FUN_004942e0 (interface shutdown).
results.summary: Main per-frame update for a local player's first-person weapon: advances state, idle animation selection, aim-sway smoothing, and interface timers.

results.name: first_person_weapon_update_animation_controls
results.evidence: Computes look yaw/pitch via fpatan/sqrt from DAT_007c3120/24/28, then builds a node control block (offset+0x8c) from unit/weapon HUD tables and feeds it through FUN_004d4a80/FUN_004d4f90/FUN_004d51a0/FUN_004d57d0/FUN_004d69e0, finally calling FUN_004d6880 with the resulting control block.
results.summary: Computes the local player's aim direction and builds the first-person weapon's animation control block (grip/trigger/lean values) each frame, feeding it to the animation-control system.

results.name: first_person_weapon_interface_initialize
results.evidence: Resets the local-player interface record's cached fields, tears down (FUN_00450d50/FUN_00455c80) or re-attaches (FUN_00450cb0) the first-person model depending on the current flag, and uses FUN_00493f00 to detect presence of two HUD elements (offsets 0x1d8c and 0x1e0e) before enabling the weapon interface.
results.summary: (Re)initializes a local player's first-person weapon interface record when the controlled unit/weapon changes, wiring up the HUD elements it finds.

results.name: local_player_set_first_person_active
results.evidence: Compares param_1 against the interface record's flag at offset 0 (same flag tested/consumed by FUN_00493c60's cVar2); calls FUN_00450cb0 to enable or FUN_00450d50+FUN_00455c80 to disable, matching an attach/detach pair rather than a 'node base address' getter.
results.summary: Enables or disables the local player's first-person weapon view, attaching or detaching the weapon model accordingly.

results.name: first_person_weapon_copy_animation_nodes
results.evidence: Loops count times (from iVar1+0xb8, a node/track count), using an index table (unaff_EBX) to gather 0x34-byte records from param_2 into a contiguous param_1 array.
results.summary: Copies a permuted set of animation-node records (indexed via a lookup table) into a contiguous output buffer for later effect/HUD processing.

results.name: hud_meter_find_matching_element
results.evidence: Iterates a HUD-interface element table (iVar2+0xbc) comparing 2-byte-at-a-time against entries of a second table (iVar3+0x6c) via a strcmp-like loop, writing the found index into param_1 and returning a success/complete flag.
results.summary: Scans a HUD interface's meter/element list for entries matching a target table, recording matches by index for later use.

results.name: local_player_index_from_current_weapon
results.evidence: Iterates local player slots via DAT_0087a478/DAT_0087a480 datum tables to a unit record, comparing its current-weapon field (offset 0x2f8 + weapon-slot*4) against param_1, returning the matching local player index or -1.
results.summary: Finds which local player currently has the given weapon object equipped.

results.name: local_player_index_from_unit_object
results.evidence: Same datum-table iteration pattern as FUN_00494010 but compares a unit's object-index field directly (offset 0x34) against unaff_EDI, returning the owning local player's index or -1.
results.summary: Finds which local player is controlling the given unit object.

results.name: first_person_weapon_process_action
results.evidence: Switches on param_2 action code: 0 nudges a float field (+0x2c), 9/10 call FUN_004726f0 (reload-related), 0xc calls FUN_00493c60 (interface init/weapon swap), 0xd clears the weapon field; validates reload eligibility using unit ammo fields (puVar3[0xae]/+0x2b6) before finally calling FUN_00492e60 to change animation state.
results.summary: Central handler that applies a weapon HUD action code (charge, reload, swap, drop) to a local player's weapon interface and drives the resulting animation-state change.

results.name: first_person_weapon_interface_shutdown
results.evidence: If the interface record's weapon field (offset+8) is valid, calls FUN_004449f0 (presumed teardown), then resets a timer field (offset+0x12) to 0x1e; invoked at the tail of FUN_00493c60 and FUN_00493150.
results.summary: Tears down/resets a local player's first-person weapon interface state and reseeds its interface timer.

results.name: interface_globals_allocate
results.evidence: Calls terminal_initialize and FUN_004a9780, then bumps DAT_006e2dcc by 0x1ea0 (matching the per-local-player interface record size used throughout this file) and folds that size into a running crc32_update, finally publishing the new base as DAT_006b2d98.
results.summary: Allocates space for one local-player interface record from a bump allocator and updates a running checksum of engine state, while also initializing the terminal/console.

results.name: interface_local_player_state_reset
results.evidence: Zeroes exactly 0x7a8 dwords (0x1ea0 bytes - the interface record size established by FUN_00494340) at DAT_006b2d98, sets sentinel -1 fields, and copies default vector/rect values from DAT_00746fa0 and PTR_DAT_006851fc into several DAT_006e47xx globals.
results.summary: Clears and re-initializes the freshly-allocated local-player interface record and a handful of related default values.

results.name: hud_meter_get_flash_color
results.evidence: Indexes a reflexive tag block (DAT_00746fa0+0x140/0x144) by param_1*0x10, then reads a cyclic (modulo count) 0x30-byte-stride color entry at param_2 into a 4-float RGBA output via in_ECX, defaulting to opaque white (1,1,1,1).
results.summary: Looks up a cyclic color entry (e.g. a flash/blink color) from a HUD meter's color-animation tag block.

results.name: hud_meter_set_active_flash_color
results.evidence: Wraps FUN_00494430 (color lookup) and stores its outputs plus param_2/3/4 into the DAT_006e472c/DAT_006e4738.. group of globals used elsewhere for a currently-displayed flash effect.
results.summary: Selects a HUD meter flash color entry and caches it as the currently active flash-effect parameters.

results.name: first_person_get_zoom_overlay_object
results.evidence: Resolves the current local player's controlled unit, checks a non-empty overlay tag name (DAT_00719420) and game mode (FUN_00445ac0), then via unit_get_weapon_object_index and nested datum lookups returns a bitmap/tag index (or falls back through FUN_0056d990) with an out parameter, matching a zoom-overlay lookup consumed by FUN_00494730/FUN_00494af0.
results.summary: Determines the zoom/scope overlay object to display for the local player's current weapon, used by the screen-effect update.

results.name: interface_update_screen_effects
results.evidence: Uses FUN_00494560 to get a zoom overlay object, computes flash/tint parameters from damage/health-like fields, and finally calls chimera__widescreen_screen_effect, FUN_004a99f0, and conditionally game_engine_post_rasterize_post_game.
results.summary: Per-frame computation of the local player's screen tint/flash and widescreen letterbox effect, followed by HUD post-render and post-game overlay handling.

results.name: first_person_update_zoom_static_flash
results.evidence: Zeroes DAT_0071d190/94/98 (an RGB triple) then, only while zoomed (via FUN_00494560) and a camera-effect flag bit is set, computes a randomized (FUN_005121a0) intensity clamped to 0.75 and stores it into that RGB triple.
results.summary: Computes a randomized static/flicker color tint applied while the local player is zoomed in, e.g. for a scope battery or camera-distortion effect.

results.name: ui_error_modal_update
results.evidence: String "error_modal"; checks DAT_006f1d20/DAT_0087aa10 (player count range) and a flag byte, looks up a widget named "error_modal" via FUN_00625430, and conditionally calls FUN_00449780 once or twice based on a count in DAT_0087a478+0xc - matches the naming-hint cea-pdb matches for ui_widgets_active_errors/force_fullscreen.
results.summary: Updates/shows the shared 'error_modal' UI widget for one or more players when an error condition and player-count conditions are met.

results.name: hud_draw_rotated_sprite
results.evidence: Builds a 4-vertex quad from a screen rect (param_1 shorts at +4/+6/+0x10/+0x12) rotated by sin/cos of param_4 and scaled by param_3, colors it via FUN_006391b4 (alpha) with RGB=white, and submits it with FUN_0051c9a0.
results.summary: Constructs and submits a rotated, scaled screen-space quad (e.g. a HUD icon or waypoint marker) for rendering.

results.name: map_list_get_friendly_level_name
results.evidence: String "ui\\shell\\main_menu\\mp_map_list"; uses tag_lookup on that tag, then a demo/known-map index lookup, and either copies a localized wide-string name or falls back to the filename via _strrchr - matches the existing non-FUN_ name and naming-hint.
results.summary: Resolves the display-friendly multiplayer level name for a map, using the built-in map-list tag when the map is a known one, else its filename.

results.name: map_list_find_known_map_index
results.evidence: Lowercases an incoming path (in_EAX) into a local buffer and linearly scans a table (DAT_00712dcc, count DAT_00712dd0) of known/built-in map path strings, returning the matching index or -1; the 'sig__' prefix is a stale hint, the code is a name-table scan rather than a signature scan.
results.summary: Looks up whether a given map path matches one of the engine's known/built-in multiplayer maps, returning its index or -1 for a custom map.

results.name: map_list_add_entry
results.evidence: Grows the DAT_00712dcc array (GlobalAlloc/GlobalReAlloc, stride 0xc) as needed, stores a path string, strips/lowercases its extension via FUN_00625430(&DAT_00669928), and finally checks cache_file_exists before incrementing DAT_00712dd0 - a single-entry append, not a bulk 'load maps' routine as the 'chimera__' hint implied.
results.summary: Appends one map-file entry (path, id, cache-exists flag) to the growable multiplayer map list, allocating/reallocating storage as needed.

results.name: map_list_append_entry_variant
results.evidence: Shares the exact tail logic of FUN_004950c0 (path copy, FUN_00625430 extension strip, lowercase, _strrchr, cache_file_exists, DAT_00712dd0++) via different register-passed inputs; the existing name 'first_person_weapons_update' does not match code that never touches any weapon or unit state.
results.summary: A near-duplicate map-list entry appender (path copy + extension handling + cache check), likely an alternate call site of the same underlying logic as map_list_add_entry; the previous 'first_person_weapons_update' name did not match the code.

results.name: map_list_finalize_entry
results.evidence: Contains only the tail of the map-list-entry logic (lowercase filename, _strrchr, cache_file_exists, DAT_00712dd0++) with no weapon/unit references, so the prior name 'first_person_weapon_render_update' does not match the code.
results.summary: Finalizes a map-list entry already stored at the current index: lowercases its path, checks cache_file_exists, and advances the entry count.

results.name: map_list_free_all
results.evidence: GlobalFree loop over DAT_00712dcc[0..DAT_00712dd0) then GlobalFree of the array itself and resetting DAT_00712dcc/dd0/dd4 to 0 - matches the existing non-FUN_ name 'chimera__free_map_index' in behavior, renamed to fit the map_list_* family established by its sibling functions.
results.summary: Frees every map-list entry's allocated path buffer plus the map-list array itself and resets the map list to empty.

results.name: player_profile_autoload
results.evidence: Tries FUN_0053c4e0(0,&id,0) then a fallback FUN_0053c4e0(0,&id,1) to obtain a profile id, validates it via FUN_0053a770, and on success calls FUN_00495970 (player_profile_load) with that id or -1.
results.summary: Attempts to automatically select and load an existing player profile at startup, falling back to a default (-1) profile if none is found valid.

results.name: player_profile_initialize
results.evidence: String "profile not saved since it was a default profile"; zeroes a 0x1829-dword profile-globals block, calls FUN_0053a1c0 and FUN_00496060, then performs the same id-resolution/validate/load sequence as FUN_004952c0 before optionally saving via FUN_0053a950 or reporting the same 'not saved' message via FUN_004c6860.
results.summary: Initializes the player-profile subsystem: clears profile globals and loads (or creates/saves) the appropriate profile at startup.

results.name: player_profile_find_index_by_id
results.evidence: Linear scan of &DAT_00714dde (a per-profile-slot short id array) comparing to in_CX, returning the matching slot index or -1; DAT_00714dde is also indexed with the same stride in FUN_00495a60.
results.summary: Finds the profile-slot index whose stored id matches the requested controller/profile id.

results.name: network_setup_screen_reset
results.evidence: Clears DAT_00714e78/DAT_00719720 (network/game-setup state flags), destroys a widget via its vtable (DAT_006f1d20+8) if present, and zeroes DAT_006b0b88 (0x300 bytes) and DAT_0087ab20 (0x98 bytes, the same size as the game-variant struct used elsewhere).
results.summary: Tears down the multiplayer game-setup UI widget and clears the transient network/game-setup state and buffers.

results.name: player_profile_apply_video_options
results.evidence: Remaps a tri-state field (in_EAX+0xa74, values 0/1/2) into DAT_0068944e, sets several DAT_006893xx video-option flags from a profile-like struct (in_EAX+0xa6f..0xa76), calls GetDesktopWindow/GetWindowRect and chimera__gamma, and flushes the render cache (cache_flush) when the mode changed; called from player_profile_load.
results.summary: Applies a set of video/display options (vsync-like mode, gamma, misc toggles) from the current profile data, flushing the cache if the mode changed.

results.name: player_profile_apply_audio_options
results.evidence: Reads byte volume fields (unaff_ESI+0xb78..0xb7f) with hard-coded defaults when DAT_007196f4 is set, scales each to a 0..1 float, and calls FUN_00548590/sound_set_effects_gain/FUN_00548680/FUN_005480f0; called from player_profile_load alongside player_profile_apply_video_options.
results.summary: Applies the current profile's audio settings (music/effects/voice volume and related toggles) to the sound system.

results.name: player_profile_load
results.evidence: Stores param_1 as the active profile id (&DAT_00714dd4)[idx*0x801] and bulk-copies a 0x2004-byte record into the current-profile globals (&DAT_00712dd8), then calls FUN_00496060, FUN_0053b620, FUN_00495580 (video options) and FUN_004957d0 (audio options), reopening network channels if the profile's port/settings changed.
results.summary: Loads a player profile record into the active-profile globals and applies its video, audio, and network settings.

results.name: player_profile_get_flag_by_id
results.evidence: Resolves a profile slot either directly (if no active network host) or via the same DAT_00714dde id-search loop as FUN_004954f0, then returns a byte from DAT_00712f0a at the matching stride-0x2004 offset.
results.summary: Looks up a per-profile flag/byte value for the profile matching the given id.

results.name: network_game_host_start
results.evidence: Disposes any existing host session (network_game_server_host_dispose), loads a game variant via game_engine_get_variant_by_name into DAT_00714de0, loads the "...connected_pregame_screen" UI widget via chimera__load_ui_widget, then creates a network host/session (network_game_server_host_create, network_session_create) and applies the variant (game_engine_apply_current_custom_variant).
results.summary: Starts hosting a multiplayer game: tears down any prior host, loads the selected variant, shows the pre-game lobby UI, and stands up the network host/session.

results.name: player_profile_select_saved_item
results.evidence: Splits unaff_EBX into a type (low nibble: 0=map-sized 0x1ffc-byte copy, 1=variant-sized 0x98-byte copy via game_engine_apply_current_custom_variant/FUN_0053bee0) and an index, copying either a default (DAT_0071d280) or validated (FUN_0053a770/FUN_0053bee0) record into the DAT_00716e7c/DAT_00714e80 working-copy globals and recording the id in DAT_00714e7c.
results.summary: Selects a saved map or game-variant entry (by combined type/id) into the profile's current working-copy buffers, or resets to defaults for id -1.

results.name: player_profile_saved_item_name_changed
results.evidence: Branches on DAT_00714e7c's low nibble (0=map, 1=variant, matching FUN_00495be0) and compares only the name portion of the working copy vs. the on-disk copy via _wcsncmp.
results.summary: Checks whether the display name of the currently-selected saved map or variant differs from its on-disk name.

results.name: player_profile_validate_saved_item_name
results.evidence: Same type-nibble branch as FUN_00495c90/FUN_00495be0, calling FUN_004a89a0 with a length matching either the map (0x18) or variant (0x30) name field, marking DAT_00719410 on success for the variant case.
results.summary: Validates the currently-selected saved map or variant's name (e.g. for uniqueness/legality) before it can be saved.

results.name: player_profile_save
results.evidence: String "profile not saved since it was a default profile" (matches existing name and cea-pdb hint); branches on DAT_00714e7c's low nibble (map/variant, same field used by FUN_00495be0/c90/e70/ea0), sanitizing (game_variant_sanitize_options) and writing the record via FUN_0053a950/FUN_0053bb50/FUN_0053d360 before calling player_profile_load to refresh state.
results.summary: Saves the currently-selected map or game-variant profile entry to disk, refusing to overwrite an unmodified default profile.

results.name: player_profile_saved_item_name_equals
results.evidence: Guarded by DAT_00714e7c != -1 (the same selected-item id used by the other 0x495xxx saved-item helpers), compares param_1 against the working-copy name via _wcscmp and packs the result with a match flag.
results.summary: Compares a given name string against the currently-selected saved map/variant's name, returning a match indicator.

results.name: player_profile_saved_item_is_modified
results.evidence: Branches on DAT_00714e7c's low nibble (map: compares 0x7ff dwords, variant: compares 0x26 dwords - the same sizes copied by FUN_00495be0) between the working copy (DAT_00714e80) and on-disk copy (DAT_00716e7c), returning whether they differ.
results.summary: Determines whether the currently-selected saved map or variant has unsaved changes by comparing its working copy against the on-disk copy.
